mechanism: Modafinil may increase dopaminergic activity while perphenazine blocks dopamine receptors, potentially reducing perphenazine efficacy and increasing psychostimulant effects; both drugs affect CNS function and modafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may alter perphenazine metabolism.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased stimulant-related adverse effects; consider dose adjustments of perphenazine if needed and counsel on CNS effects.
